problem_statement.value: Using the attached prior-art note and lab results, design a passive chlorination device that does not suffer tablet bridging. Keep it reagent-refillable without power.

desired_outcome.basis: no outcome verb phrase found in the user text

observed_failure.basis: no failure noun phrase found — the problem may be opportunity-shaped rather than failure-shaped

context.basis: deterministic surface features of the message

domain_hypothesis.basis: keyword score 1 (hits: power); full ranking recorded in domain_scores

physical_system.basis: system noun phrase matched in the user's message

target_variable.basis: quantity word matched in the message (outcome-object phrases included as fallback candidates)

unknowns.why_unknown: no outcome verb phrase found in the user text
unknowns.what_would_resolve: one user sentence naming the desired outcome

unknowns.why_unknown: no failure noun phrase found — the problem may be opportunity-shaped rather than failure-shaped
unknowns.what_would_resolve: one user sentence naming the observed failure

assumptions.assumption: the message describes ONE engineering problem
assumptions.falsified_by: a second unrelated objective in the text

success_condition.basis: cannot be composed — outcome or target unknown

failure_condition.value: the mechanism does not materially change the target variable, introduces a larger failure mode, or is contradicted by admissible evidence
failure_condition.basis: the engine's standing falsification contract (Art. XX/LII)

user_evidence.basis: user-uploaded documents (server-side extraction; content hash on record) — inputs, never scientific verdicts
